title: Absorption feature extraction
description: Generic continuum-removed band-feature extraction over a configurable window (analysis/spectrometry/features.py::extract_feature) — presets (Al-OH/Mg-OH/Fe-OH/H2O/OH) are just named default windows (feature_presets.py), never hardcoded into the algorithm. quality_indicator flags no_feature_detected/minimum_at_edge/multiple_local_minima/shallow_feature instead of crashing on ambiguous spectra.

response.results: [{feature_id, spectrum_id, sample_id, preset_name, center, depth, width_fwhm, area, asymmetry, method, window_min, window_max, continuum_method, quality_indicator, calc_date}]
